question: Heat and climate: how far above normal was Indonesia's 2025 mean temperature (BMKG)?
finding: National mean air temperature 2025 was 27.05 deg C against a 1991-2020 normal of 26.7 deg C, an anomaly of 0.38 deg C (115 BMKG stations).
unit: deg C anomaly vs 1991-2020 normal (national mean, calendar 2025)
quote: Berdasarkan data dari 115 stasiun pengamatan BMKG, suhu udara rata-rata periode 1991-2020 di Indonesia sebesar 26.7 °C dan suhu udara rata-rata tahun 2025 sebesar 27.05 °C, sehingga anomali suhu udara rata-rata tahun 2025 sebesar 0.38 °C.
gaps: No Jakarta-only temperature series found at BMKG in this run (gap ENV-017).
notes: PESTEL dim: Environmental. Fact only. Interpretation (heat raises cooling load / cold-drink demand) is analysis, not sourced.

question: Jakarta plastic-bag ban: who is bound and what is allowed?
finding: Pergub DKI 142/2019 (official JDIH Jakarta text): managers of shopping centres, supermarkets/minimarkets and traditional markets must use reusable "eco-friendly" bags and may not use single-use plastic shopping bags (Art. 5); shopping-centre managers must impose this on every tenant (Art. 6(1)(a)-(b)); every tenant (pelaku usaha) must not provide single-use plastic shopping bags at its premises and must sell reusable bags, not free, near the till (Art. 6(2)(a)-(b)); supermarkets must sell reusable bags near the till (Art. 9(1)(b)); single-use plastic packaging bags remain allowed for unwrapped food until a greener alternative exists (Art. 7).
unit: qualitative rule
instrument: Pergub DKI Jakarta 142/2019 (JDIH Jakarta record 3851, full text PDF)
quote: Pengelola Pusat Perbelanjaan, Toko Swalayan, dan Pasar Rakyat wajib menggunakan Kantong Belanja Ramah Lingkungan. || Pelaku Usaha di Pusat Perbelanjaan dapat menyediakan Kantong Kemasan Plastik Sekali Pakai. (2) ... hanya dapat digunakan untuk mewadahi bahan Pangan yang belum terselubung kemasan apapun.
gaps: Whether a stand-alone street cafe outside a mall is bound is not clear from the articles (they bind mall, supermarket and market managers; Art. 9(2) on stand-alone supermarkets read only in part). Takeaway cups and straws are not addressed.
applies_to_entry_mode: own PT PMA; JV in PT PMA; local licensee
notes: Interpretation: a mall-based cafe is bound through the mall manager. Food-and-drink takeaway bags/cups are not addressed in the opened articles. Audit follow-up (2026-10-17): upgraded from tier-3 Pasal.id relay to the official JDIH Jakarta full text (https://jdih.jakarta.go.id/link/download-fulltext/3851, opened 2026-10-17, article numbers and quotes checked against the PDF).
